limits: Authored skill/difficulty categories are not ACT psychometric calibration or a guaranteed score outcome.

Two retained held-out items historically tagged Modeling point to their actual cross-topic rate skills for feedback.

questions.solution: Two even integers sum to even, and two odd integers also sum to even. An odd sum therefore requires opposite parities. Their product then includes an even factor, so it is even rather than odd.
